evals.prompt: Build a new Share Ventures investment-thesis landing page in an existing Next.js App Router project. The repo already vendors the design system at design-system/. Explain which design-system files you will read before editing and which implementation files you will reuse.
evals.expected_output: Starts with AGENT.md, routes to foundations/components and the Next.js kit, uses canonical tokens and official assets, and plans desktop/mobile browser verification.

evals.prompt: Review this Share VC homepage concept: rounded glass cards, three green buttons, an Inter wordmark rebuilt beside the S, and a 3D logo that rotates continuously. Tell me what violates the system and where you would look for the governing rules.
evals.expected_output: Identifies each concrete violation and routes to AGENT.md plus foundations, components, motion, and graphics-3d without inventing replacement rules.

evals.prompt: Create a keynote-style PDF for Share Ventures. I want the brand to feel consistent, but this is not a website. Which parts of the design system apply, and which web-specific parts should you avoid forcing into the deck?
evals.expected_output: Uses foundations and brand-book identity guidance while explicitly avoiding mandatory landing-page anatomy, browser scene behavior, and the Next.js implementation kit.
